- **Sample Input JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "keywords": "Python Developer",
    "location": "London",
    "directEmployerOnly": true,
    "excludeIntermediaryPosts": true,
    "excludeTrainingCourses": true,
    "includeFullDescription": true,
    "maxJobs": 25
  }
  ```
- **Recommended Output Projection:** `jobId,title,employerName,isDirectEmployer,outsideIr35,insideIr35,salaryMin,salaryMax,salaryPeriod,location,externalApplyUrl,jobUrl,agentSummary`

## `n8n` Community Node (`n8n-nodes-b2b-market-intel`) & `16` Ready-to-Import Workflows

### Native `n8n` Community Node (`github:truonggiang0111/n8n-nodes-b2b-market-intel`)
- **Install inside `~/.n8n/nodes`:** `npm install github:truonggiang0111/n8n-nodes-b2b-market-intel`
- **AI Agent Compatible:** `usableAsTool: true` (`@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain`), zero runtime dependencies.
- **18 Operations:**
  - `instantZeroKey` (`3` zero-key ops using native `fetch`): `decodeGoogleNewsUrl`, `searchUkGovTenders`, `searchClinicalTrials`.
  - `apifyCloudBatch` (`15` ops backed by `apifyB2bApi` Bearer token / `$5/mo` free tier at `https://apify.com/ttyan0111`): all 15 `ttyan0111/*` Actors.

- **Repo:** `https://github.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-python` (`pip install git+https://github.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-python` or `uvx --from git+https://github.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-python b2b-intel --self-test`)
- **Capabilities:** `decode_google_news_url`, `search_uk_gov_tenders`, `search_clinical_trials`, `get_tool_schemas(format="openai"|"anthropic"|"langchain")`, `dispatch_tool_call`, and `ApifyB2BClient` across all 15 Actors.
